definitions.label: Gas quantity and cylinder sizes

definitions.label: Opening hours

definitions.label: Payment integration enabled
definitions.description: Protective disable is immediate. Enabling requires a verified provider adapter.

definitions.label: Inventory valuation method
definitions.description: Explicit method selection; incomplete acquisition costs always make valuation unavailable.

definitions.label: Audited points adjustment
definitions.description: One immutable customer adjustment per approved request. Reason and evidence required. No wallet transfer.

definitions.label: EasyRewards policy
definitions.description: Versioned point economics. Example rates are not approved. Requires independent owner and finance approvals; technical flags remain separate.

definitions.label: Referral risk review
definitions.description: Hold, clear or block a referral with evidence and independent owner/finance approval. Shared addresses are not proof of fraud.

definitions.label: Reward earning enabled
definitions.description: Earn configured points only on delivered independently verified purchases.

definitions.label: Spend per reward point (kobo)
definitions.description: Verified product spend required for each point. Delivery fees excluded.

definitions.label: Wallet credit per redeemed point (kobo)
definitions.description: Customer-authorised conversion of points into purchase credit.

definitions.label: Retention and win-back policy
definitions.description: Thresholds and conservative monthly message budget; default disabled

definitions.label: Maximum purchase credit funding
definitions.description: Funding remains unavailable until a verified payment integration is connected.

definitions.label: Payment on delivery
definitions.description: Permit unverified cash-on-delivery orders; payments stay unpaid.

definitions.label: Settlement account
definitions.description: Bank metadata only. Two independent approvers and recent password verification are required.

definitions.description: Sandbox only. Independently approved fee versions and funding controls; secrets remain server-side. Live activation is unsupported.

definitions.label: Customer testimonials
definitions.description: Explicit text and photo consent, eligibility and moderation are mandatory. Photo publication is revalidated on every request and withdrawn images are never publicly cached.
